notes.title: The Diofield Chronicle Update ver1.20
notes.content:
[list]
[b][*]Additional new story content starring Waltaquin Redditch[/b]Follow the events from Waltaquin joining the Blue Fox up to Chapter 5 and see the story unfolding from her perspective.
 
[b][*]New gameplay mechanics, maps, missions and boss[/b]Featuring new events that present Waltaquin’s thoughts and deliberations as options for the player. Explore new maps, take on new missions and fight the fearsome new boss “Behemoth”.
 
[b][*]New equipment and skills[/b]The new “Magic Tome” equipment type and the “Necrotiem” skill that can be used with it open up new tactical possibilities, not seen in the original game.
 
[b][*]New difficulty level and play mode unlocked after completing the game[/b]This update introduces the new “Very Hard” difficulty level that offers players an even more satisfying challenge, as well as an extra mode where the difficulty level is pitched at players who have completed the main story.
 
[*] Adjustments to game balance in certain areas.
[/list]

notes.title: Free Update Coming March 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088068/138953d8aedded745369e35a6d329bb9443c2495.png[/img]
A free update is coming to The DioField Chronicle in March 2023, which includes a new story, a new weapon, new skills, and additional challenges!

[list][*][b]NEW STORY[/b][/list]
Play through a new scenario as Waltaquin and use powerful Necromancy skills with the newly added Grimoire. Summon Skeletal Knights and fearsome Skeletal Dragons to force your enemies into submission!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088068/0a3c13c6aa3a5575ce17e31854cb632d24c9b739.png[/img]

[list][*][b]NEW BOSS[/b][/list]
Face off against the mighty Behemoth!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088068/3b804d6a6f53b08a6ad10cc5a7aee65b378d3299.png[/img]

[list][*][b]EXTRA MODE[/b][/list]
The free update will include a new difficulty option for New Game+.
A new difficulty level, Very Hard, will also be added.

Follow [url=https://twitter.com/DiofieldGame]The DioField Chronicle on Twitter[/url] for more updates!

notes.title: Square Enix анонсировала обновление для The DioField Chronicle — в игру добавят новую историю, оружие и уровень сложности
notes.content: Square Enix готовит масштабное обновление The DioField Chronicle. В марте 2023 года в игру добавят новый сценарий, оружие, навыки, режим и уровень сложности. Весь контент будет бесплатным.

notes.title: The DioField Chronicle is available now!
notes.content:
The era of myths gives way to an era of great turmoil…

The world of men is mired in upheaval, as an age of war rages for years on end.

A mercenary band arise from amidst the flames and the chaos, they who's fated deeds will be sung of in ages yet to come.

But when all is said and done, will the name "Blue Fox" come to be a byword for hope or darkest tragedy?

notes.title: Deluxe Edition Early Access Available Now!
notes.content:
Customers who pre-purchased the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION can play the game now!

■A new Strategy RPG, brought to you by Square EnixAn all-new Strategy RPG that chronicles an epic tale of war and honour. Featuring a unique and beautiful world that blends fantasy, medieval and modern-day influences, and a deep yet innovative real-time battle system.

■Deep, strategic, real-time tactical battles
The battles in this game are defined by real-time assessment of battlefield conditions and issuing decisive orders that take advantage of your troops strengths and weaknesses to gain advantage over your foe. Make clever use of a variety of skills, classes and equipment to complete your mission.

■Realistic "diorama" style battle scenes
Richly detailed depictions of the environments of the island of DioField combined with unique "diorama" style visuals as you command your forces like a general.

notes.title: Try out the free The DioField Chronicle DEMO!
notes.content:
Presenting a free demo of  The DioField Chronicle, that allows you to carry over your progress to the full game.
In this demo you can play from the game's opening through to the end of chapter 1.

*This demo consists of a section taken from the full game.
*It is possible to carry over save data from the demo to the full game
*It is possible to carry over game progress and character levels to the full game.
*Content may vary from the full game.
